name: Suzuki GT185 / GT250
engine: 184 or 247 cc air-cooled two-stroke twin, two carbs, CCI oil injection, Ram Air head
intro: Suzuki's small two-stroke twins of the 70s. Ram Air cylinder heads, CCI oil injection and points.

B: Suzuki's CCI system pumps oil into the engine, so it does not need premix. Check the oil tank, pump and lines. If the pump was removed, it runs premix.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
